newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 7 T-bill issues worth 40.9 bln levs.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 7 T-bill issues worth 40.9 bln levs.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry sold two regular and placed another five special discount T-bill issues worth a total of 40.902 billion levs on Monday, the central bank said.
The two regular issues have periods of maturity of one and four weeks, respectively, while the special ones mature within eight to 25 days.

"The special issues were placed with the State Savings Bank, which considered the yield more attractive than the yield of short-term repos offered by the central bank," a finance ministry official told Reuters.
Under finance ministry regulations the ministry can place special government securities issues on request with local financial institutions under specifically agreed maturities and selling prices.

The ministry has offered regular one- and four-week discount T-bill issues with no minimum acceptable price or par value set in advance at daily auctions since January 20. Auction dates and issue dates of those issues overlap.
Details of Monday's issues follow. Prices are in percent of par.
